name: Vampire - Multiattack (Vampire Form Only) - Successes
description: Flavor text for successes a action

results.text: The vampire's bite sinks deep as his other claw rips flesh with unholy savagery!
With inhuman speed, he strikes twice—one fang, one talon—a symphony of carnage.
A flash of crimson and steel; both attacks land, leaving victims gasping for breath.
The vampire's dual strike is a dance of death, ending with a scream of agony.
His claws rend while his fangs pierce, the scent of blood thick in the air.
